svg.title: The globe beneath the lid
svg.desc: The eyeball and both lids wrap around a sphere. The brow ridge, tear lake, lid crease and lower orbital plane must turn in depth rather than become flat graphic outlines. Seven-second native SVG loop. 0–1 s: quiet open gaze; 1–2 s: brow anticipates a glance; 2–2.17 s: the upper lid closes; 2.17–2.45 s: the eye reopens; 2.45–4.8 s: iris looks laterally while the brow holds; 4.8–6 s: gaze returns; 6–7 s: initial pose is restored.
